name: Acceptance test 16 - third-party trust protected by ExternalId (role-trust, supported)
note: IAM-801: role-trust is supported. A cross-account/root trust gated by sts:ExternalId is a confused-deputy CONSTRAINT that lowers severity to low/medium (TRUST-CROSS-ACCOUNT). ExternalId is recognized as a per-customer confused-deputy mitigation - NOT authentication, NOT a secret - and the analyzer never reports it as 'missing'. The target role's permissions remain out of scope/unknown.
